rationale_text: Case 10339_1000345: a 2.40 cc lesion in the transition zone is mildly hypointense/indeterminate on T2W (z=0.03 relative to same-zone background tissue) with round to oval, more circumscribed (sphericity=0.72) margins. A substantial portion of the lesion falls outside the automated whole-gland segmentation, suggestive of extraprostatic extension (note: the gland mask is AI-derived and not verified at the capsule boundary, so this may partly reflect gland-segmentation imprecision rather than confirmed extension). These measurements are consistent with PI-RADS category 5.
